heroSummary: West Ada’s 2025–26 school year began Wednesday, August 13, 2025, and ended Friday, May 22, 2026. Thanksgiving Break ran November 24–28, Winter Break December 22–January 2, and Spring Break March 16–20. Seniors finished May 15. On October 9, grades K–8 had no school for conferences while grades 9–12 remained in session and held evening conferences.

definitions.description: Students did not attend September 10, November 4, January 28, or March 4. January 5 was a teacher prep day with no school for students.
The official PDF lists no school for all grades but does not give a holiday, staff-development, or calendar-adjustment reason. This page keeps the official wording rather than assigning one.
The senior last day was Friday, May 15, one week before the districtwide last day on Friday, May 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When did West Ada start school in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day was Wednesday, August 13, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was West Ada Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. January 5 was a teacher prep day with no school for students, and classes resumed January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was West Ada Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran March 16–20, 2026, and classes resumed March 23.

calendarFaqs.q: Did high school students have October 9 off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. October 9 was a no-school conference day for grades K–8. Grades 9–12 remained in session and held evening conferences.

calendarFaqs.q: Why was there no school April 10, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: West Ada’s official PDF states only that all grades had no school. It does not provide a reason, so this page does not assign one.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day for West Ada seniors?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors finished May 15, 2026. The districtwide last day was May 22.
